title: [KBM] New editor: honor the PowerToys language setting

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: Private malformed-language and supported-language fixtures are prepared for an isolated profile. The existing three tests exercise an older helper candidate and do not cover the current inline guard, so they are not counted as validation. A deterministic predicate/setter boundary and three focused cases are specified but not implemented or run. Actual startup failure remains unreproduced and requires a disposable interactive Windows profile without modifying active-user settings or registry. The current candidate remains unbuilt and unsupported as an author-facing finding.

next_action: Resume the saved review stage in the next dashboard update.
